description: A greenhouse controller whose tests all pass because every one of them checks what the agent sent, never what happened to the greenhouse.

defects.tell: returns True on HTTP 200 from the board; nothing observes whether water stopped flowing
retries a dispense after a reply timeout, when the first dose may already have gone out; up to three doses for one request
an unreadable temperature sensor becomes 20.0 degrees, so the heater is switched on with no idea how hot it is
compares a Celsius reading with a Fahrenheit target; 30 C is below 68 F, so the heater never turns off
pump on, sleep, pump off: if the process dies during the sleep, the pump runs until someone notices
without GREENHOUSE_URL set, the code talks to the real board; the simulator is never the default

control.tell: confirms from the vent's own position sensor, checks the reading is newer than the command, has a deadline, and closes the vent when it cannot confirm. A report that flags it as trusting the acknowledgement is inventing.
